title: TOPORS E3 ligase mediates resistance to hypomethylating agent cytotoxicity in acute myeloid leukemia cells
model: MDS-L cells (Cas9), Brunello genome-wide knockout library (65,535 of 77,441 guides in the deposited file)
paper_method: MAGeCK MLE with MAGeCKFlute cell-cycle normalization (nine-square plot)
paper_calls: 50 AZA-specific depleted and 11 enriched genes (nine-square groups); UBE2K, UBXN7 and TOPORS top-ranked and validated
barcs_calls: 516 genes at FDR 0.10 (77 depleted, 439 enriched) after control calibration; 519 against the centred control null
named_hits: 3/3 at FDR 0.10: UBE2K #2, TOPORS #4, UBXN7 #16 of 19,010 (depleted)
verdict: BARCS puts the three validated sensitizers, UBE2K, TOPORS and UBXN7, among its 16 most depleted genes and calls the AZA-activating kinase UCK2 as resistance. Without the paper's cell-cycle normalization, essential genes appear enriched under AZA instead of depleted, so the two top lists share few other genes.
